strings.en: Let's do this, RaiOh...!
RaiOh! I'm staking everything on you!
I'll show you the guts I built/　working part-time jobs...!
All I've got to sell is spirit and guts!
There's gotta be something I can do...!
I decided I'd pull this off...!
Gauge the distance...! Now!!
Focus! The enemy's right in front of you!
I'm making the first move!
Waiting it out isn't my style...!
Don't hesitate...!/　Hesitation slows you down!
Take my fighting spirit... head-on!
Strike first to win... Here I go!
I'll end this...! Faster than my foe!
Breakthrough! Tear right through!
Let's go, RaiOh! It's time for our fight!
RaiOh! Let's smash 'em!
Watch me, Minaki...!
Minaki's watching too...! I can't lose!
I'll fight...! As long as I have Mettle!
I'll put my soul into RaiOh!
My Spirit's at full...! And RaiOh will deliver it!
Time to show what my new part-time job taught me...!
You scum! I'll kick you to pieces, no tricks!
Jua-Mu! I'll show you an Earthling's pride/　and Potential!
Jua-Mu! I'll kick your obsession to pieces!
We're going to outrun the Raftclans, RaiOh!
I'll meet his ambition head-on with my Mettle...!
Al-Van! Let's settle this fair and square!
I'll take out the Commander and end this!
That man carries himself/　like a true warrior...!
Woman or not, if you're an enemy, I won't/　show mercy...!
I'll kick open a path to retreat!
Karo-Ran!/　I'll teach you how scum like you end up!
Gu-Landon!/　I'll stop your ambitions, no matter what!
It's over, Gu-Landon! Fight fair and square!
I'm not going to hold back against/　people who sneak around in the shadows...!
Get ready, Iradoya!
I'll beat that rotten nature of yours.../　No, that business sense, into shape!
We're forcing our way through, Gadisword!
Vort! I'll kick you to pieces, scythe and all!
I'm coming through, Reggiane!
Herluga!/　RaiOh and I will kick your ambitions to pieces!
Pretty clumsy for a clown!
He's only using Kaana types...?!
Debudedabide! Take my strike!
How does an amoeba pilot a machine...?!
No choice! I'll destroy that machine!
So we're cleaning up after the Zovorg...!
I'll kick that crystal body to pieces!
Let's go! RaiOh's going dragon slaying!
Skull Knight! Time for you to return to the earth!
Don't think you'll get off with broken bones,/　Skull Knight!
Why does that thing talk like it's from Osaka?!
XN-L! I won't accept your conclusion!
XN-L, I'll beat you with everything I've got!
If you lay a hand on Earth, you'll answer to us!
You guys never learn!
Get a load of Earthling guts!
I'll make you take a huge loss, Golaikunru!
Crooked merchants...! Go earn an honest living!
The Zovorg Commander unit...!/　A worthy opponent!
Don't think a Commander unit will intimidate me...!
I'll slip through the barrage and land a finishing blow!
Break through at one point...! I'll punch right/　through that hulk!
Swift as lightning! Speed is my game!
Even with no weight classes, I'll win!
I won't let you lay a finger on them!
A new Zovorg model...! I'll take you on!
So the Zovorg brought out a new model...!
I'll snap that tube in half!
I'll smash you, armor and all!
I won't think about how much kicking thorns/　might hurt...!
It's a Thorn...! I can't let my guard down!
Bring it, Gadisword!/　I'll knock you out of the sky!
For now, I'll focus on falling back!
Whatever the new model's after,/　what I have to do doesn't change!
Let's go, RaiOh! Time to exorcise some ghosts!
I'll crush as many Lamaris as I can!
Begone, evil spirit! Time to disappear, Lamaris!
I'll blow away that malice with my Mettle!
If they Combine, I'll kick them all to pieces at once...!
A Kaana type...! I'll wipe it out here!
Kaana or not, nothing can stop RaiOh!
Just how big are these Lamaris going to grow...?!
No matter how huge you get!
So you've wandered out, Ares Geist...!
After I stop him, it's up to you, Arieil!
Get out of the way, Ares Geist!
Let's go exterminate some monsters!
Begone, evil spirits!/　Here I come, Yokijin!
I'm not soft enough to flinch/　at how you look...!
You hit me, I hit back...!
I'll meet force with force...!
You're not getting away!!
Hey! You start a fight and then run?!
Whoa! Here's your change, customer!
Guess striking first didn't quite work out!
I was waiting for this! The opening after an attack!
Damn! Is this all I've got...?!
Things are getting pretty dicey...!
Minaki's... my RaiOh can still fight!
My part-time jobs never put me/　in a pinch like this...!
Damn!/　I'll have to stake everything to win this!
Gwah...!/　Did I crack a rib too...?!
Take a cut to land the killing blow.../　I'm not done yet!
Hang in there, RaiOh...!/　This is where it counts!
My Mettle and RaiOh are both still alive!
Life lies in the jaws of death...!/　Now I'll show what all my training was for!
Now it's a contest between his obsession/　and my Mettle!
Al-Van...! You're good, for an enemy!
I-Is that all you've got, Fu-Ruu?!
You didn't have that last push, Karo-Ran!
Gu-Landon!/　You're the one man I will never lose to!
I won't be swallowed by Gomoudokka's ambitions...!
Barely kept my head on my shoulders...!
Reggiane!/　If you think you'll get to see my blood, think again!
No matter what, I have to pull him/　away from the Cross Gate...!
Damn...!/　I fell right into Debudedabide's trap!
Don't think you've won yet, Crystal Dragoon!
Skull Knight!/　If you want to beat RaiOh and me, come at full power!
My Mettle... Minaki's feelings.../　They give me the courage to face XN-L...!
I'll show you my grit, Fury!
Ngh! I felt that to my core!
Crap! I totally misjudged the distance!
The vigor I built working part-time/　will see me through...!
I've been in tighter spots than this/　at my part-time jobs!
Why, you... You'll pay for that!
Tch! That one really landed!
Crap...! My head's spinning...!
This is nothing...!/　As long as I can move, I fight!
Kh! It took advantage of my doubts...!
RaiOh's pain is my pain! No more of this!
Kh! The last thing I want is to make So-Des happy!
Jua-Mu! Your obsession sure is top-class!
Al-Van! I won't back down a single step!
You're careless at the finish, Fu-Ruu!
My head's still attached, Karo-Ran!
Damn! So the Knight Commander title/　isn't just for show!
This is bad, I'm getting caught up in her pace...!
I won't let Gomoudokka do as he pleases!
Damn! That machine's power is top-class!
At this rate, I'll fall prey to that scythe...!
Like I'd let things go the way Reggiane wants!
Don't think you've won, Herluga!/　I can still fight!
Persistent!/　You're set on biting at me no matter what?!
I hate to admit it, but that's some fine magic...!/　Not that I feel like applauding!
Crystal Dragoon.../　It calmly went for my weak spot!
Let it cut the flesh to break the bone!/　I'm turning this around!
Guh! XN-L's power is no joke...!
Not yet! I'll keep drawing it toward me!
If I can't do something about this bombardment,/　there's no chance of winning...!
Just what I'd expect from a Thorn. That stings...!
Am I being overwhelmed by its evil aura?!
Lamaris in numbers really are something, huh...!
Ugh! Is that thing really a Lamaris?!
Ares Geist's speed/　is going up even more?!
Wh-What is this sick feeling...?!
Ow! I bonked my head!
Let me tell you! I can take a beating!
I got hurt worse than this all the time/　back when I worked part-time!
Let's fight, RaiOh! I can still move!
Whoa, did I charge in too far...!
Dammit! They got past my guard...!
Damage like this.../　just sets my mettle on fire!
Like I'd flinch at a little scratch!
Like I'd drop to my knees over this!
Why, you...! I'll pay you back tenfold!
Dammit!/　I couldn't read their attack...!
If you want to make me flinch, bring ten times that!
You've lit a fire under my Mettle!
Your selfish desires won't shake my Mettle!
Too shallow, Al-Van!
Sorry,/　but I'm not planning on becoming your prey!
Is that all, Karo-Ran?!
Gu-Landon!/　Your twisted ambition won't beat my Mettle!
Iradoya... Trying to shake me up...!
What's wrong, Gomoudokka?! Is that all you've got?!
Is that scythe just for decoration?!
That won't be enough to see my blood!
Looks like you can't control the Cross Gate's power!
An attack with no soul in it won't work on me!
Just a cheap magic trick!
If that was meant to intimidate me, it failed,/　Crystal Dragoon!
Is that all, Skull Knight?!
What's wrong, XN-L?!
You never learn, Zovorg!
Earthling vigor won't break that easily!
Good, so far so good...!
I can't fully dodge the Thorn's attacks...!
Getting bitten by some fake ghost/　is no big deal!
Even after you Combine,/　that's all the power you have?!
This pressure...!/　If I take a direct hit, I'm done for...!
That thing...! It's faster than before...!
I just can't read their attacks...!
Crap! I think it grazed my scarf...!
All right! I can see their moves!
That attack... I've got it read!
Things won't go your way that easily!
RaiOh and I have become one...!
That attack's pure emotion, Jua-Mu!
All talk, So-Des!
Al-Van! So you came at me fair and square!
I've seen through you, Fu-Ruu!
Dodged it, Gu-Landon!
Iradoya! You won't lead me astray!
Come at me for real, Gomoudokka!
I'm not going to fall prey to your scythe!
I've seen through you, Reggiane!
Even with the Cross Gate's power,/　if it doesn't hit...!
Debudedabide! I've seen through your tricks!
I've already got some dragon-slaying experience!
Where are you looking, Skull Knight?!
That's your limit, XN-L!
I know how you guys operate...!
Bring it on! I'll take on every last one of you!
Like I'd let a Lamaris possess me!
I'll parry every one of the Kaana type's attacks!
I can't let the Ida hit me...!
Are those wings just for decoration?!
Your bloodlust gives you away, Yokijin!
Too slow, you monster mech!
Fluke or not, a success is a success!
Nice, RaiOh! Your response is spot-on!
As long as I don't get hit, I'll win...!
Nice, RaiOh! We can do this!
Nice moves! All thanks to Minaki's tuning!
Karo-Ran, RaiOh is right here!
Like that'd work!
An attack like that is nothing!
Hang in there, RaiOh!
Damn! Did I get too cocky!?
Tch! Short range is my weak spot...!
If I can't reach, I'll just close in...!
I can handle a little support too!
Leave the cleanup to me!
It's not over yet!
We're going too, RaiOh!
Ryusei! Leave the rest to me!
I'll follow your lead too, Major!
Major Kai! Time to show you/　the results of my training!
Rätsel, I'll go next!
That's Rishu-sensei for you!/　A perfect example!
Nice one, Kota! I'm right behind you!
Ibis made an opening for me, so...!
Watch this, Raul! I'm up next!
Touya! Leave the rest to me!
Nice attack, Akimi!
I'll lend you a hand, Akemi!
I'll show you how we do it on Earth, Sieg!
Sally, I'll take it from here!
Haken's style of attack... That's a good example!
Hold on, RaiOh!
Get behind me!
Taking hits is my specialty!
Block it, RaiOh!
If it's toughness, I've got plenty!
We'll endure it with Spirit, RaiOh!
Major Sänger, look out!
Fall back, Major Kai!
Rätsel, I'll take this one!
I won't let them get Rishu-sensei!
Kota! Fall back!
You're being targeted, Ibis!
A rescuer who gets shot down is no use!
I'll be a shield for Touya and the others!
Fall back, Akimi!
Akemi, get out of here, now!
Here comes the real one!
Don't think one hit is all you get!
Nobody said I only get one attack!
This chance... I'm not letting it slip away!
Take that! Overhead!
Punch through, Haken!
Haken Impulse!
Haken! Impulse!!
Impulse Shoot!!
You're not escaping this!
Roar, Plasma Beute!
Plasma Beute, deploy!
Plasma Beute! Don't let them get away!
Haaaaah!
Right theeere!
Counter Break!
Shatter! Counter Break!
Rise up, tornado!
Take this! Thunder Drop!!
This ends it! Lightning Fall!
Raaaaaaah!!
This'll settle it!
Lightning Fall! Break through!!
I see it...!
Haaaah...!
Now for the killing blow...!
I'll end it here!
Focusing my spirit...!
Fly, RaiOh!
I'll put my soul into this...!
Seiyaaah!!
Raaaaaaaaaaah!!
Hah! Hah! Hah! Hah!
Seeeeeeeiyaaah!!
Raaaaaaaaaagh!!
Teyaaaaaaah!
Take this!!
Finisher!!
Rising Meteorrrr!!
Rising Meteor!
This is the eeeend!!
Fly! Faster than lightning! Stronger!
Rushing Spin!
I'll close the distance in one go!
Haah!
High roundhouse kick!
Here it comes, my finishing combination!
The fruit of my training, right here!
Hyah!
Hah!
Fly!
Let's finish this, RaiOh!
Raging!
Striiiiike!!
Ever-changing!
These moves!
You can't read them!
Raging Strike!
At a single point!
I'll kick you to pieces!!
